To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) CP-violating nucleon sigma terms can be calculated from lattice QCD, (b) CP-violating p-n couplings can be calculated from nucleon sigma terms, (c) the required lattice QED calculations are feasible, (d) lattice QCD calculations are needed to reduce theoretical uncertainties in EDM experiments, (e) the required lattice calculations are feasible and (f) the resulting reduction of theoretical uncertainties is significant.

(i) chiral symmetry relations can be used to calculate CP-violating p-n couplings from lattice QCD, (ii) these relations are reliable at next-to-next-to leading order in both S U(2) and S U(3) chiral perturbation, and (iii) the required lattice QED calculations are feasible

(1) CP-violating pionic couplings to nucleons can be calculated from lattice QCD by using chiral symmetry relations, (2) chiral perturbation-theory relations between pionic couplings and nucleon sigma terms are reliable at next-to-leading order, and (3) chiral symmetry relations are also reliable at next-to-next-to-next-to-leading-order in the S U ( 6 ) limit of S U ( 4 ) chiral perturbative theory

a lattice QCD calculation of the CP-violating pionic couplings that are relevant to nuclear and diamagnetic atom EDMs in the context of beyond-the-Standard-Model physics.
a new approach for the lattice QCD calculation of CP-violating nucleon couplings to pions.
lattice QCD calculations that are aimed at reducing the theoretical uncertainties in EDM experiments.

the lattice calculation of the CP-violating nucleon sigma terms is a very promising way to improve our theoretical knowledge about CP-violating nuclear matrix elements.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have shown how to use lattice QCD to calculate CP violating pion–nuclear couplings, and we have demonstrated that these couplings can be calculated to a precision that is comparable to the expected precision of future nuclear EDM experiments.
we provide the first lattice QCD strategy to calculate the CP-violating pionic matrix elements that dominate the interpretation of EDM measurements.
lattice spectroscopy can be used to determine pion–nuclear couplings with an accuracy of 10% or better.

the lattice QCD community can make a significant contribution to improving the theoretical understanding of EDM experiments.
lattice QCD spectroscopy can provide valuable input to the interpretation of EDM experiments.
lattice QCD spectroscopy is a promising avenue towards an improved theoretical understanding of the nuclear EDMs.
